sloka: इत्येवंवादिनं तं तु शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम् ।वाल्मीकिः सम्परिष्वज्य विससर्ज च राघवम् ।। ७.७२.५ ॥
transliteration: ityevaṁvādinaṁ taṁ tu śatrughnaṁ śatrutāpanam ।vālmīkiḥ sampariṣvajya visasarja ca rāghavam ।। 7.72.5 ॥

translations.english: Having embraced Shatrughna, the tormentor of foes, who was speaking thus, Valmiki sent him off to Rama.
